findings.title: Amount claimed differs from total of hospital bill and pharmacy bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital final bill and the outside pharmacy invoice.

findings.title: Billed investigation has no corresponding lab or radiology report in the file
findings.detail: Investigation Charges of 2384.56 are billed on the hospital bill, but no matching report is present in the file.

findings.title: Admission date on claim form differs from hospital bill and discharge summary
findings.detail: The admission date reported on the claim form is 10/09/2024, whereas the hospital bill and discharge summary state 13 Sep 2024.
